title: mut.channel_jared_tarbell_substrate
mutation_directive: Channel Jared Tarbell's 'Substrate' algorithm. Spawn lines from random edge points; each line grows perpendicular forward. When a line crosses an existing line, it stops AND spawns a new line at the crossing point at 90 degrees. Iterate until coverage. Render the resulting line graph as particle clusters along each segment with subtle color variation per generation. Result: architectural maze, urban-organic, recognizably algorithmic but warm.
